patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce and SugarCRM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Salesforce and SugarCRM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Salesforce only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and ” rather than SugarCRM's shape. Choose SugarCRM only if your buying job matches “Customer experience CRM (Sugar Sell) with Standard through Premier editions and Sugar Inte” rather than Salesforce's shape. Workflow advantage: Salesforce leans outbound-sales, high-volume-lead-management; SugarCRM leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce and SugarCRM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

- Workflow coverage skew: Salesforce-leaning outbound-sales, high-volume-lead-management vs SugarCRM-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Salesforce — USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; SugarCRM — Confirm live SugarCRM checkout; packaging can change..

Limitations — Salesforce: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us.; SugarCRM: Confirm live SugarCRM checkout; packaging can change..

Poor-fit cases: Salesforce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual).
